title: Evaluation of the converted decision tree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional binary cube to the signs, and let $T$ be a decision tree on that cube with sign outputs. If $T$ computes $f$ after identifying binary coordinates with sign coordinates, then the sign-valued hypothesis tree obtained from $T$ evaluates to $f$ on every sign vector.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$T$ is a sign-valued decision tree on the $n$-dimensional binary cube
$T$ computes $f$ under the binary-to-sign coordinate identification
